title: The Private Files of Rex Saunders
paragraphs: Short-lived NBC detective/adventure vehicle starring Rex Harrison as Rex Saunders with Leon Janney as assistant Alec. Frozen collection has thirteen regular broadcast recordings plus the April 13 Game With Death audition; the regular May 23 episode-4 slot lacks a distinct frozen network aircheck.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: Game With Death audition (April 13, 1951 to April 13, 1951) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] and NBC/RCA Victor regular run (May 2, 1951 to August 1, 1951) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Edward Adamson (writer), Himan Brown (director), Leon Janney (performer), Rex Harrison (performer), Kenneth Banghart (announcer), Alice Frost (performer), and Amzie Strickland (performer).

The stories often return to murder and criminal plots, Rex Saunders and Alec partnership, private detective investigation, celebrity star vehicle, RCA Victor sponsored network radio, and edited/syndicated preservation copy.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Rex Harrison radio star vehicle, Edited Rex Saunders preservation copies, 1951 NBC/RCA Victor Rex Saunders run, and April 1951 Game With Death audition.
